exposure: Standard screening for gestational diabetes (24-28 weeks)
Early screening for gestational diabetes (16-18 weeks)
finding: Early screening for gestational diabetes in high-risk women did not significantly improve short-term maternal-fetal outcomes compared to standard screening, although women diagnosed early were more likely to receive insulin therapy.
mod_finding: The study found no difference in the prevalence of Cesarean section, operative delivery, or other maternal and fetal outcomes between women with early versus standard screening and diagnosis of gestational diabetes.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight measured, specific values not reported
